name: Shinjuku
tagline: Shinjuku in 1 minute and Shibuya in 5 minutes. Served by 13 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥120,000 to ¥130,000.
summary: The station is in Shinjuku City, where JR East, Keio, Odakyu, Tokyo Metro and the Tokyo Metropolitan Bureau of Transportation run 13 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 20 minutes to Otemachi, 1 minute to Shinjuku, 5 minutes to Shibuya and 24 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥120,000 to ¥130,000. The station stands 37.5 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 9.0 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 37.5 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 31.3 m to 40.3 m, a difference of 9.0 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Even so, 3 of the nine points within 400 m fall inside the area, and the deepest projection there is 0.5 to 3 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is on the small side for the 23 wards.

groceries.name: まいばすけっと 代々木1丁目店

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 18 clinics and 34 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is myhospital, about 6 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 日本心臓血圧研究振興会附属榊原記念病院, about 6 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 13 lines serve the station. JR Yamanote Line and JR Chuo Main Line run through it. JR Chuo Rapid Line also call here. JR Chuo-Sobu Line (Local) are available too. JR Saikyo Line and Narita Express stop here as well. JR Shonan-Shinjuku Line and Keio Line stop here as well. Keio New Line and Odakyu Odawara Line stop here as well. Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line stop here as well. Toei Oedo Line and Toei Shinjuku Line stop here as well. The lines are split between operators (JR East runs 7 lines, Keio runs 2 lines, Odakyu runs 1 line, Tokyo Metro runs 1 line and the Tokyo Metropolitan Bureau of Transportation runs 2 lines), so when one line stops you can change to a line run by a different company.
congestion: JR Saikyo Line runs at 167% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 板橋→池袋, which this station is not on. JR Chuo Rapid Line runs at 158% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch of the line is 中野→新宿, which includes this station. Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line runs at 154%. Its busiest stretch is 新大塚→茗荷谷, which this station is likewise not on. JR Chuo Main Line, Narita Express, JR Shonan-Shinjuku Line and Keio New Line is not covered by the ministry's congestion survey. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥120,000 to ¥130,000 and 1K ¥130,000 to ¥140,000. 1LDK ¥230,000 to ¥240,000 and 2LDK ¥340,000 to ¥350,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.
drivers: Age and construction of the building
Whether it faces a main road or the railway
Whether it sits at the top or the bottom of a slope

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥120,000 to ¥130,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is among the lowest in the 23 wards. 13 lines and a wide choice of connections and plenty of places to eat out pushes the figure up. On the other side, little daily shopping within walking distance holds it down. For 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: For how little of the area is in the flood projection, Shinjuku-Nishiguchi; for how close the centre is, Shinjuku.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Shinjuku. Both have the Toei Oedo Line. Shinjuku also has the 12 lines, which Shinjuku-Nishiguchi does not. Shinjuku is at least 8 minutes quicker to Tokyo and Shinagawa. On how easy the shopping is, though, Shinjuku-Nishiguchi comes out ahead. Within about 13 minutes' walk, Shinjuku-Nishiguchi has 11 supermarkets (TOMIZ and ドン・キホーテUNY and others) and Shinjuku has 4.

neighbours.lead: For how easy the shopping is, Shinjuku-Sanchome; for how close the centre is, Shinjuku.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Shinjuku. Both have the Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line and Toei Shinjuku Line. Shinjuku adds the 11 lines; Shinjuku-Sanchome adds the Tokyo Metro Fukutoshin Line. Shinjuku is at least 5 minutes quicker to Roppongi and Shinagawa. A one-room flat also costs about ¥19,000 more at Shinjuku-Sanchome. On how easy the shopping is, though, Shinjuku-Sanchome comes out ahead. Within about 13 minutes' walk, Shinjuku-Sanchome has 7 supermarkets (ドン・キホーテUNY and MEGAドン・キホーテ and others) and Shinjuku has 4.

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 4 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 2 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself is outside the projected flood area, but blocks nearby are inside it.
leads.stationNote: 13 lines serve the station, and the choice of connections is wider than at most stations in the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are among the lowest in the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is among the highest in the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Morning trains are very crowded: this station sits on the busiest stretch of the JR Chuo Rapid Line.
